title: Sprint 6d: the secrets file made once, and each repository's agent at one click

steps.say: 6d-1. Before you start, on the laptop in your own account: start this walk from ~/git/porelo-frontend with mkdir -p ~/.porelo/walk && cp doc/walks/18-sprint-6d-the-secrets-file-and-the-agents.json ~/.porelo/walk/walk.json && PORELO_WALK=$HOME/.porelo/walk flutter run -d linux. You need a machine whose Porelo is 0.5.1~snapshot.344 or later and a project on it whose project.yml names an agent for at least one repository (agent: stub works on a test machine). Nothing is rented in this walk. Expected: the interface opens with this panel beside it.
6d-2. Open Projects in the rail, choose your project, then its menu and Put this project on a server…. Expected: the wizard opens at Where it is rented.

6d-3. Fill Where it is rented, The project and Your ssh keys as for a real setup, clicking Next after each. Nothing is rented before the last page. Expected: Your secrets file opens next, its field showing your home's Porelo/secrets.kdbx and, where there is no file yet, that setup makes it with a master password you choose.
6d-4. Click Make it now (Open it now, where the file is there already). Expected: a terminal opens on this computer and asks a master password.

6d-5. In the terminal, type a new master password, then the same again. Expected: nothing you type is shown, then The secrets file is ready. Click Done. A second password that differs must end with The two did not match; nothing was made, and no file.
6d-6. Expected on the step: Ready: the file keeps the server's keys. Click Leave and confirm: nothing is rented.

6d-7. In a separate terminal (it asks your master password): keepassxc ~/Porelo/secrets.kdbx. Expected: the groups shared and hosts, and under hosts/<your project> the entries wireguard and vault-passphrase, each with a password set. Close KeePassXC.

6d-8. Open Projects, choose the project that names agents, then its menu and Start an agent for each repository…. Expected: one row per repository naming an agent, with the name it goes by as the machine says it; a repository that names none is listed as naming none and is not offered; one whose agent runs already says so.

6d-9. Leave out one repository by unchecking it, then click Next. Expected on Sign-ins: The machine says every agent to start can start, or a Sign in to <agent> button for an agent with nothing stored. Where there is one, click it, sign in in its terminal, and see this step ask again by itself.

6d-10. Click Next, read the summary (each task new or continuing, the one you left out named), then Start them. Expected: each row says <name> is starting, then <name> started (or <name> continues for one brought back), one after another; a refused row says <name> was not started with the machine's words, and the others go on. The first start on a project never prepared waits for its image to be built.

6d-11. Open the project's menu and Start an agent for each repository… once more. Expected: nothing is offered again, since each runs. Stop the tasks you started for this walk from their tiles, if they were only for the test. Then tell me what differed.
